Unlike historical precedents where manufacturing was merely relocated inland away from immediate combat, Ukraine's current initiative involves establishing high-tech aerospace assembly under active missile threat, utilizing modular underground infrastructure and decentralized micro-facilities rather than sprawling industrial complexes.
